messages:
maya: quick flag note — seeing duplicate quota hits when api-proxy coalesces SA claims. same request billed to project+org.
ron: can you paste minimal trace? is coalesce header present?
maya: flow:
```
proxy recv X-API-Key=svc-AA11
auth -> sa@proj-77/org-3
coalesce -> Effective-Identity=sa:svc-AA11@proj-77
router -> billing.project=proj-77
quota increments proj-77
quota increments org-3
```
kevin: root cause: quota service treats X-Orig-* audit headers as attribution if effective header exists. precedence bug.
anita: propose simple precedence: 1) Effective-Identity, 2) X-Orig-* only if no effective. add tag auth_route=coalesced|orig.
ron: telemetry: emit requests.auth.attribution_fallback{reason="orig_used"} and requests.auth.coalesced_count, label proxy_version and auth_flow.
kevin: rollout: behind feature-flag auth_coalesce_v2 + quota_preview_mode that logs WOULD_CHARGE (no billing) until 100% ramp.
anita: Console panel: "Attribution drift" with mismatch rate, top proxies, top projects/orgs, drill to traces.
maya: retention: traces 7d, aggregates 90d.
dev-bot: checklist created: feature_flag=auth_coalesce_v2, metrics=[requests.auth.coalesced_count,requests.auth.attribution_fallback], quota_preview_mode.
kevin: Ill PR header-precedence + preview mode tests.
ron: will add proxy toggle for audit headers + integ test asserting no double increments when Effective-Identity present.
anita: mock panel by EOD.
maya: thanks — sync tomorrow 10:30 to review sandbox numbers :thumbsup:
